⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
A time-evolving stream of encoded audio chunks.

[`archetypes.AudioStream`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/archetypes/audio_stream?speculative-link) is the streaming counterpart of [`archetypes.AssetAudio`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/archetypes/asset_audio?speculative-link):
each logged row is a self-contained, decodable segment and the row's
timeline timestamp is treated as the presentation timestamp (PTS) of the
first PCM sample in the segment.

Static components (`codec`, `sample_rate`, `channel_count`, `channel_layout`,
`priming_delay`) are expected to be constant over the lifetime of the
stream and are typically logged once with `static=True`. The per-row
components (`chunk`, `duration_samples`, `stream_id`, `sequence_number`,
`discontinuity`, `seekable`) are logged with each segment.

Segments may arrive out of order in the log but the viewer resumes
playback from the nearest preceding seekable boundary on any seek.
